raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00, which duplicated 345 txn_ids. The second copies carry txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (1768543211000 = 2026-01-16 06:00:11 UTC, identical to the original string), so the TIMESTAMP cast fails, and the duplicates would also double-count once the cast is fixed. The fix parses both formats and keeps the earliest-ingested copy of each txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(txn_ts), '^[0-9]{12,14}$') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT) * 1000) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
